  <script>
    (() => {
      const reducedMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
      const sparkleCanvas = document.querySelector("#bg-canvas");
      const sparkleContext = sparkleCanvas.getContext("2d");
      const transformButton = document.querySelector("#transform-button");
      const musicToggle = document.querySelector("#music-toggle");
      const musicLabel = musicToggle.querySelector(".music-label");
      const magicFlash = document.querySelector("#magic-flash");
      let audioContext = null;
      let masterGain = null;
      let ambientBus = null;
      let ambientTimer = 0;
      let musicEnabled = false;
      let flashTimer = 0;
      let animationFrame = 0;
      let lastFrame = 0;

      const randomBetween = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
      const particles = Array.from({ length: 76 }, () => ({
        x: Math.random(),
        y: Math.random(),
        radius: randomBetween(.6, 2.1),
        phase: randomBetween(0, Math.PI * 2),
        speed: randomBetween(.00004, .00018),
        drift: randomBetween(.00008, .00035),
        hue: Math.random() > .5 ? "gold" : (Math.random() > .5 ? "pink" : "teal")
      }));

      const drawSparkles = (time, staticFrame = false) => {
        const width = window.innerWidth;
        const height = window.innerHeight;
        sparkleContext.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
        particles.forEach((particle, index) => {
          if (!staticFrame && lastFrame) {
            const elapsed = Math.min(time - lastFrame, 50);
            particle.y -= particle.speed * elapsed;
            particle.x += Math.sin(time * .00035 + particle.phase) * particle.drift * elapsed;
            if (particle.y < -.02) {
              particle.y = 1.02;
              particle.x = Math.random();
            }
            if (particle.x < -.02) particle.x = 1.02;
            if (particle.x > 1.02) particle.x = -.02;
          }
          const pulse = staticFrame ? .4 : (.25 + (Math.sin(time * .0017 + particle.phase) + 1) * .3);
          const x = particle.x * width;
          const y = particle.y * height;
          const color = particle.hue === "gold" ? `rgba(224,190,99,${pulse})` :
            particle.hue === "pink" ? `rgba(207,115,161,${pulse * .72})` : `rgba(91,177,186,${pulse * .72})`;
          sparkleContext.beginPath();
          sparkleContext.fillStyle = color;
          sparkleContext.shadowColor = color;
          sparkleContext.shadowBlur = particle.radius * 5;
          sparkleContext.arc(x, y, particle.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          sparkleContext.fill();
          if (index % 8 === 0 && pulse > .48) {
            sparkleContext.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,249,222,${pulse * .58})`;
            sparkleContext.lineWidth = .7;
            sparkleContext.beginPath();
            sparkleContext.moveTo(x - particle.radius * 2.3, y);
            sparkleContext.lineTo(x + particle.radius * 2.3, y);
            sparkleContext.moveTo(x, y - particle.radius * 2.3);
            sparkleContext.lineTo(x, y + particle.radius * 2.3);
            sparkleContext.stroke();
          }
        });
        sparkleContext.shadowBlur = 0;
        lastFrame = time;
        if (!staticFrame && !reducedMotion && !document.hidden) {
          animationFrame = window.requestAnimationFrame(drawSparkles);
        }
      };

      const resizeSparkleCanvas = () => {
        const ratio = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 1.5);
        sparkleCanvas.width = Math.floor(window.innerWidth * ratio);
        sparkleCanvas.height = Math.floor(window.innerHeight * ratio);
        sparkleCanvas.style.width = `${window.innerWidth}px`;
        sparkleCanvas.style.height = `${window.innerHeight}px`;
        sparkleContext.setTransform(ratio, 0, 0, ratio, 0, 0);
        drawSparkles(performance.now(), true);
      };

      const updateMusicControl = () => {
        musicToggle.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(musicEnabled));
        musicToggle.setAttribute("aria-label", musicEnabled ? "Tắt nhạc nền" : "Bật nhạc nền");
        musicLabel.textContent = musicEnabled ? "Tắt nhạc nền" : "Bật nhạc nền";
      };

      const ensureAudio = () => {
        if (audioContext) {
          if (audioContext.state === "suspended") void audioContext.resume();
          return true;
        }
        const AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
        if (!AudioContextClass) return false;
        audioContext = new AudioContextClass();
        masterGain = audioContext.createGain();
        masterGain.gain.value = .72;
        masterGain.connect(audioContext.destination);
        if (audioContext.state === "suspended") void audioContext.resume();
        return true;
      };

      const playPianoNote = (frequency, startTime, gain = .12) => {
        if (!audioContext || !ambientBus) return;
        const fundamental = audioContext.createOscillator();
        const overtone = audioContext.createOscillator();
        const envelope = audioContext.createGain();
        const overtoneGain = audioContext.createGain();
        fundamental.type = "triangle";
        fundamental.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency, startTime);
        overtone.type = "sine";
        overtone.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency * 2.01, startTime);
        envelope.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001, startTime);
        envelope.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(gain, startTime + .018);
        envelope.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001, startTime + 1.7);
        overtoneGain.gain.value = .16;
        fundamental.connect(envelope);
        overtone.connect(overtoneGain);
        overtoneGain.connect(envelope);
        envelope.connect(ambientBus);
        fundamental.start(startTime);
        overtone.start(startTime);
        fundamental.stop(startTime + 1.75);
        overtone.stop(startTime + 1.75);
      };

      const startAmbientMusic = () => {
        if (!ensureAudio() || ambientTimer) return false;
        ambientBus = audioContext.createGain();
        ambientBus.gain.value = .68;
        ambientBus.connect(masterGain);
        const melody = [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 659.25, 587.33, 698.46, 880, 698.46, 523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.5, 880, 698.46, 659.25, 587.33];
        let noteIndex = 0;
        const playNextNote = () => {
          if (!ambientBus) return;
          const startTime = audioContext.currentTime + .025;
          const note = melody[noteIndex % melody.length];
          playPianoNote(note, startTime, .09);
          if (noteIndex % 4 === 0) playPianoNote(note / 2, startTime, .065);
          noteIndex += 1;
        };
        playNextNote();
        ambientTimer = window.setInterval(playNextNote, 620);
        return true;
      };

      const stopAmbientMusic = () => {
        window.clearInterval(ambientTimer);
        ambientTimer = 0;
        const previousBus = ambientBus;
        ambientBus = null;
        if (!previousBus || !audioContext) return;
        previousBus.gain.setTargetAtTime(.0001, audioContext.currentTime, .1);
        window.setTimeout(() => previousBus.disconnect(), 650);
      };

      const playTransformationSound = () => {
        if (!ensureAudio()) return;
        const now = audioContext.currentTime;
        const notes = [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.5, 1318.51];
        notes.forEach((frequency, index) => {
          const start = now + index * .095;
          const oscillator = audioContext.createOscillator();
          const envelope = audioContext.createGain();
          oscillator.type = index === notes.length - 1 ? "sine" : "triangle";
          oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency * .72, start);
          oscillator.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(frequency, start + .2);
          envelope.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001, start);
          envelope.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(index === notes.length - 1 ? .22 : .105, start + .035);
          envelope.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001, start + 1.15);
          oscillator.connect(envelope);
          envelope.connect(masterGain);
          oscillator.start(start);
          oscillator.stop(start + 1.2);
        });
        const shimmer = audioContext.createOscillator();
        const shimmerGain = audioContext.createGain();
        shimmer.type = "sine";
        shimmer.frequency.setValueAtTime(1760, now + .28);
        shimmer.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(2640, now + .85);
        shimmerGain.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001, now + .28);
        shimmerGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.075, now + .42);
        shimmerGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001, now + 1.05);
        shimmer.connect(shimmerGain);
        shimmerGain.connect(masterGain);
        shimmer.start(now + .28);
        shimmer.stop(now + 1.1);
      };

      const burstMagic = (fromUserAction = false) => {
        if (reducedMotion && !fromUserAction) return;
        magicFlash.style.setProperty("--flash-x", `${randomBetween(38, 62)}%`);
        magicFlash.style.setProperty("--flash-y", `${randomBetween(32, 58)}%`);
        magicFlash.classList.remove("is-active");
        window.clearTimeout(flashTimer);
        void magicFlash.offsetWidth;
        magicFlash.classList.add("is-active");
        flashTimer = window.setTimeout(() => magicFlash.classList.remove("is-active"), 1000);

        const originX = window.innerWidth * randomBetween(.38, .62);
        const originY = window.innerHeight * randomBetween(.35, .58);
        const colors = ["#fff3bc", "#f6bfe0", "#b8f2ee", "#d6c5ff"];
        for (let index = 0; index < 72; index += 1) {
          const sparkle = document.createElement("span");
          const angle = (Math.PI * 2 * index) / 72 + randomBetween(-.11, .11);
          const distance = randomBetween(100, Math.max(220, Math.min(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight) * .78));
          sparkle.className = "burst-sparkle";
          sparkle.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
          sparkle.textContent = index % 3 === 0 ? "✦" : (index % 3 === 1 ? "✧" : "·");
          sparkle.style.left = `${originX}px`;
          sparkle.style.top = `${originY}px`;
          sparkle.style.setProperty("--burst-x", `${Math.cos(angle) * distance}px`);
          sparkle.style.setProperty("--burst-y", `${Math.sin(angle) * distance}px`);
          sparkle.style.setProperty("--sparkle-color", colors[index % colors.length]);
          sparkle.style.setProperty("--sparkle-size", `${randomBetween(11, 24)}px`);
          sparkle.style.setProperty("--burst-duration", `${randomBetween(1.15, 2.15)}s`);
          document.body.appendChild(sparkle);
          sparkle.addEventListener("animationend", () => sparkle.remove(), { once: true });
        }
      };

      const transformMagic = (showScene = true) => {
        playTransformationSound();
        burstMagic(true);
        document.body.classList.add("transformation-opt-in");
        window.setTimeout(() => document.body.classList.remove("transformation-opt-in"), 6500);
        if (showScene) {
          const transformationScene = document.querySelector("#transformation-scene");
          transformationScene.classList.remove("is-active");
          void transformationScene.offsetWidth;
          transformationScene.classList.add("is-active");
          window.setTimeout(() => transformationScene.classList.remove("is-active"), 6400);
        }
        document.body.classList.remove("intro-complete");
        void document.body.offsetWidth;
        document.body.classList.add("intro-complete");
        window.setTimeout(() => document.body.classList.remove("intro-complete"), 1800);
      };

      resizeSparkleCanvas();
      window.addEventListener("resize", resizeSparkleCanvas, { passive: true });
      if (!reducedMotion) animationFrame = window.requestAnimationFrame(drawSparkles);
      document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
        if (document.hidden) window.cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
        else if (!reducedMotion) animationFrame = window.requestAnimationFrame(drawSparkles);
      });
      transformButton.addEventListener("click", transformMagic);
      musicToggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
        if (musicEnabled) {
          musicEnabled = false;
          stopAmbientMusic();
          updateMusicControl();
          return;
        }
        if (!startAmbientMusic()) {
          musicLabel.textContent = "Âm thanh không hỗ trợ";
          musicToggle.disabled = true;
          musicToggle.setAttribute("aria-label", "Thiết bị không hỗ trợ nhạc nền");
          return;
        }
        musicEnabled = true;
        updateMusicControl();
      });

      const intro = document.querySelector("#magic-intro");
      const introButton = document.querySelector(".intro-enter");
      const pageContent = [
        document.querySelector(".site-header"),
        document.querySelector("main"),
        document.querySelector("footer"),
        document.querySelector(".back-top")
      ];
      let introClosed = false;

      const closeIntro = () => {
        if (introClosed) return;
        introClosed = true;
        document.body.classList.remove("intro-playing");
        document.body.classList.add("intro-complete");
        pageContent.forEach((element) => { element.inert = false; });
        intro.classList.add("is-leaving");
        window.setTimeout(() => { intro.hidden = true; }, 950);
      };
      const transformAndEnter = () => {
        if (introClosed) return;
        transformMagic(false);
        introButton.disabled = true;
        introButton.textContent = "Phép thuật đang thức tỉnh ✦";
        intro.classList.add("is-transforming");
        window.setTimeout(closeIntro, 1700);
      };

      document.body.classList.add("intro-playing");
      pageContent.forEach((element) => { element.inert = true; });
      intro.hidden = false;
      if (!reducedMotion) {
        const stars = intro.querySelector(".intro-stars");
        for (let index = 0; index < 38; index += 1) {
          const star = document.createElement("i");
          star.style.setProperty("--star-x", `${Math.random() * 100}%`);
          star.style.setProperty("--star-y", `${Math.random() * 100}%`);
          star.style.setProperty("--star-size", `${Math.random() * 2 + 1}px`);
          star.style.setProperty("--star-delay", `${Math.random() * 1.2}s`);
          stars.appendChild(star);
        }
      }
      introButton.addEventListener("click", transformAndEnter);
      window.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
        if (event.key === "Escape" && !introClosed) closeIntro();
      });
      let touchStartY = null;
      window.addEventListener("wheel", (event) => {
        if (introClosed || Math.abs(event.deltaY) < 4) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        closeIntro();
        window.setTimeout(() => window.scrollBy(0, event.deltaY), 80);
      }, { passive: false });
      window.addEventListener("touchstart", (event) => {
        if (!introClosed) touchStartY = event.touches[0].clientY;
      }, { passive: true });
      window.addEventListener("touchend", (event) => {
        if (introClosed || touchStartY === null) return;
        const deltaY = touchStartY - event.changedTouches[0].clientY;
        touchStartY = null;
        if (Math.abs(deltaY) < 12) return;
        closeIntro();
        window.setTimeout(() => window.scrollBy(0, deltaY), 80);
      }, { passive: true });

      const revealItems = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal");
      const backTop = document.querySelector(".back-top");

      if (reducedMotion || !("IntersectionObserver" in window)) {
        revealItems.forEach((item) => item.classList.add("is-visible"));
      } else {
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries, currentObserver) => {
          entries.forEach((entry) => {
            if (entry.isIntersecting) {
              entry.target.classList.add("is-visible");
              currentObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
            }
          });
        }, { threshold: 0.14 });
        revealItems.forEach((item) => observer.observe(item));
      }

      if (!reducedMotion && "IntersectionObserver" in window) {
        const energyObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries, currentObserver) => {
          entries.forEach((entry) => {
            if (entry.isIntersecting) {
              entry.target.classList.add("is-active");
              currentObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
            }
          });
        }, { threshold: 0.55 });
        document.querySelectorAll(".energy-bridge").forEach((bridge) => energyObserver.observe(bridge));
      }

      const updateBackTop = () => {
        backTop.classList.toggle("visible", window.scrollY > 500);
      };
      window.addEventListener("scroll", updateBackTop, { passive: true });
      updateBackTop();

      if (!reducedMotion && window.matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)").matches) {
        let lastSparkle = 0;
        window.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
          const now = performance.now();
          if (now - lastSparkle < 65) return;
          lastSparkle = now;

          const sparkle = document.createElement("span");
          sparkle.className = "sparkle";
          sparkle.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
          sparkle.textContent = Math.random() > 0.5 ? "✦" : "✧";
          sparkle.style.left = `${event.clientX}px`;
          sparkle.style.top = `${event.clientY}px`;
          document.body.appendChild(sparkle);
          sparkle.addEventListener("animationend", () => sparkle.remove(), { once: true });
        }, { passive: true });
      }
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
